title: Kevin Kline Joins Meryl Streep for Netflix’s Midwestern Family Drama ‘The Corrections’
excerpt: Kevin Kline teams up with Meryl Streep in Netflix’s limited series adaptation of Jonathan Franzen’s novel.
body:
## A Star‑Studded Reunion
Fans of classic cinema will be thrilled to hear that Kevin Kline is set to share the screen with Meryl Streep once again, this time in Netflix’s upcoming limited series, *The Corrections*. The casting news, reported by Variety, confirms that Kline will play Alfred Lambert, the aging patriarch of a Midwestern family, while Streep returns as the matriarch determined to bring her three adult children together for one final Christmas.

## From Page to Screen
*The Corrections* is based on Jonathan Franzen’s bestselling novel of the same name. The story, described in the series logline as a sharply comic portrait of a family whose siblings wrestle with their mother’s wishes and their own lofty ambitions, will be adapted for television by Franzen himself, who also serves as an executive producer. The project was first announced in April with Streep attached, and the addition of Kline now rounds out the core family dynamic.

## A Familiar On‑Screen Pair
Kline and Streep are no strangers to each other’s work. Their collaboration began with the 1982 drama *Sophie's Choice*, which marked Kline’s feature debut and earned Streep her second Academy Award. The duo later appeared together in *A Prairie Home Companion* and *Ricki and the Flash*, cementing a chemistry that many viewers still remember fondly. Their reunion in *The Corrections* promises to bring that same depth to a new generation of storytelling.

## Kline’s Versatile Turn
In the series, Kline’s character, Alfred Lambert, is a once‑powerful family head confronting the challenges of aging. He must navigate a modern family landscape: a daughter with secrets he can no longer shield, an older son who has overtaken him as the family’s authority, and a wayward son whose forgiveness he seeks. While Kline is best known for his film work—including an Oscar‑winning turn in *A Fish Called Wanda*—he has also built a solid television résumé, lending his voice to *Bob’s Burgers* and starring in recent series like *American Classic* (MGM+) and *Disclaimer* (Apple TV).

## Behind the Scenes
The series will be produced by wiip, with Mark Roybal and Paul Lee executive producing alongside Nicole Clemens and Amy Sayres. Cord Jefferson will both executive produce and direct every episode, while Paramount Television Studios (soon to become Warner Bros. Television Studios) handles production. Both Franzen and Streep are also executive producers, ensuring the adaptation stays true to the novel’s tone.

Fans can look forward to a witty, heartfelt exploration of family dynamics, anchored by two of Hollywood’s most respected actors. Keep an eye on Netflix for the premiere date, and get ready for a fresh take on a beloved literary classic.

*Source: Variety*
